'''Highest Exalted Ruler of Korad''' was a self-proclaimed title that was assumed by the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Slythor]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
